text:
kate: quick heads up, opened lightweight RFC + SDK patch to emit `X-RW-Client-Units` for opt-in client-side metering. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pulls/1122

raul: summarise impact for console/ingest pls

kate: ingestion will capture `client_units` and tag `client_metered=true`. server enforcement unchanged. SDK default = off, opt-in via `clientMetering: true` in constructor.

ingest-team: need new field in raw events and route index mapping. also please include `metering_schema_version` so we can evolve later.

ui-team: ux idea: keep default chart as-is, add overlay "Client units (opt-in)" off by default. add tooltip noting advisory nature.

raul: ops asks for backfill plan. propose backfill to `client_units=1` for missing headers for first 14 days, gated by feature-flag per-account.

ingest-team: agree on backfill but require opt-out flag. we'll implement `client_metering_backfill=false` per org if they opt out.

kate: SDK note: no breaking changes, minor bump. adding simple logger call when header sent. tests included.

ci-bot: CI: unit tests passed, integration flaky test retried, succeeded. PR merged to main.

ui-team: i'll open dashboard PR to add overlay toggle + adoption tile (percent of requests with header).

raul: docs: add explicit sentence: "Server-side quotas remain authoritative; client units are advisory only."

kate: thanks all. tagging followups: @ingest-team (mapping + backfill flag), @ui-team (overlay + tile), @raul (docs + feature flag list).
